competir.nota.cap-reached.nrg: Cycle cap reached: the round goes to the species with the most energy.

competir.nota.locked: The season already has matches: format, match values and rules are locked until the next season.

competir.progreso.enColinaSeguidas: {base} · on the hill: {champ}, {streak} in a row
competir.sorteo.cup: A World cup needs its entrants before the first match: it draws them at every new season.
competir.sorteo.next-season: From the next season on (this one started with its list).
competir.sorteo.koth: The challengers of every fight come from the pool; the season ends with a retirement or after {cap} fights (3 × {n}).
competir.sorteo.koth-endless: The challengers of every fight come from the pool; the season never ends ({n} in the draw).
competir.sorteo.ladder: Each newcomer is drawn when its turn comes, up to {n} on the ladder.
competir.sorteo.first-match: {n} are drawn when the first match starts.
competir.tv.tv-pool-short: The draw pool ({pool}) has fewer than 2 bots: TV mode off.
competir.tv.tv-pool-few: The draw pool ({pool}) has fewer than 2 readable bots: TV mode off.
competir.tv.tv-cup-size: A World cup needs 8, 16 or 32 entrants; this edition drew {n}: TV mode off.
competir.tv.tv-pool-fight: The draw pool has too few readable bots for the next fight: TV mode off.
competir.tv.round-running: The season has a background round: TV mode off.
competir.como.elo: tops the Elo at the fight cap
competir.como.dry: tops the table when no fresh challenger is left
competir.fmt.koth: king of the hill, {k} per fight
competir.regla.normal: Whoever reaches {need} round wins or more takes it (more than √N + N/2). If nobody gets there, one more round is played.
competir.regla.minimo: Whoever reaches {need} round wins or more takes it (more than √N + N/2). With {rounds}, not even winning them all is enough: the match runs at least {min} rounds.
competir.regla.tope: The first species to win {wins} rounds takes the match. Otherwise, from round {rounds} on, whoever has {need} wins or more (√N + N/2).
competir.colina.retiro: The first to win {n} in a row retires undefeated and takes the season; if nobody does, it ends after 3 × entrants fights and the Elo decides.
competir.colina.sinFinCoronas: The season never ends: {n} wins in a row earn a 👑 and a fresh hill; the most 👑 lead the table.
competir.colina.sinFin: The season never ends: the champion stays until beaten. Start a new season to reset it.
competir.colina.sinRepetir: No repeats: a bot that has fought never challenges again (the champion defends while it wins), and the season also ends when no fresh challenger is left.
competir.formato.single.desc: Everyone in the same world, up to 20. The last one standing wins.
competir.formato.single.explica: One match with every entrant (up to 20: with more, the first 20 play).
competir.formato.koth.desc: The winner stays and meets the next challenger.
competir.formato.rr.desc: Everyone against everyone, one or two legs.
competir.formato.ladder.desc: Each newcomer enters at the bottom and climbs by winning.
competir.formato.ladder.nota: they enter one at a time, in joining order
competir.formato.ladder.explica: The first one takes rung 1 without fighting. Each newcomer challenges from the top down: if it wins, it takes that rung and pushes the rest down; if it loses to everyone, it goes last.
competir.formato.cup.desc: Groups of 4 and a knockout bracket.
competir.formato.cup.explica: Round robin groups of 4; the top 2 of each group go to the bracket (1A–2B, 1B–2A…). A void match is played again.
competir.formato.swiss.desc: Rounds between equals on points, never the same opponent twice.
competir.formato.swiss.explica: With {bots} bots and auto rounds, {n} rounds are played (⌈log2 N⌉ + 1). Win 1 point, bye 1; ties broken by Buchholz, Elo and rounds won by extinction. A void match is played again.
competir.campo.k.ayuda: Species in each fight on the hill: the champion plus drawn challengers.
competir.campo.retire.ayuda: Wins in a row to retire undefeated (on the endless hill, 0 = never).
competir.campo.noRepeat.ayuda: A bot that has fought this season never challenges again; the champion defends while it wins.
competir.campo.swissRounds.ayuda: Auto = ⌈log2 N⌉ + 1: 6 rounds for 17 to 32 entrants.
competir.campo.legs.ayuda: 1 = each pair meets once; 2 = twice, with the seeding order swapped.
competir.campo.groupLegs.ayuda: 1 = each pair of a group meets once; 2 = twice.
competir.campo.third.ayuda: The semi-final losers play for third place before the final.
competir.campo.qty.ayuda: How many bots of each species are seeded at the start of every round (each entrant can set its own).
competir.campo.nrg.ayuda: The energy every bot has when a round starts.
competir.campo.rounds.ayuda: A match is a series of rounds; each one goes to the last species standing. With N, the match is decided after N rounds: the winner needs more than √N + N/2.
competir.campo.wins: Wins to take the match (0 = off)
competir.campo.wins.ayuda: The first species to win this many rounds takes the match right away. Useful with 3 or more species.
competir.campo.cap.ayuda: Longest a round can last, in cycles. When reached, the round goes to the species chosen by the criterion.
competir.campo.capMode: At the cap, the round goes to
competir.campo.capMode.ayuda: Who wins a round that reaches the cycle cap.
competir.campo.capMode.pop: the species with the most bots
competir.campo.capMode.nrg: the species with the most energy
competir.campo.popCap.ayuda: When a species has more bots than this, its poorest ones (nrg + body × 10) are removed. Keeps fast breeders from slowing the match down.
competir.nuevo.paso1.ayuda: Choose how they meet. Then pick the bots from the Library (their DNA frozen when they join) and the rules from a scenario.
competir.nuevo.paso2.ayuda: Entrants come from the Library: a fixed list or a draw from a pool. Each one's DNA is frozen when it joins.
competir.nuevo.paso3.ayuda: The match world is a scenario without species; the match values decide the seeding and when each round ends.
competir.nuevo.bloqueo: Format, match values and rules are locked from the first match of the season.
competir.entrantes.fixed.desc: the ones you pick; they carry over to the next season.
competir.entrantes.random.desc: N from the pool, drawn again at every season.
competir.entrantes.random.ayuda: They are drawn when the tournament is created and again at every new season.
competir.entrantes.fight.desc: each fight's entrants come from the pool when it is played (a World cup draws per season).
competir.entrantes.fight.ayuda: Entrants join as the pool draws them; each keeps the DNA it had when it joined.
competir.val.pocos: At least 2 entrants are needed (there are {n}).
competir.val.copa: A World cup needs 8, 16 or 32 entrants (there are {n}).
competir.val.single: A single match plays the first {max}; there are {n}.
competir.val.rrLargo: ⚠ A round robin with this many entrants means {n} fixtures.
competir.val.poolCorto: The pool has {n} bots: at least 2 are needed.
competir.val.nMin: The draw has to be of 2 or more.
competir.val.nMayorPool: The pool only has {pool} bots: all of them are drawn (you asked for {n}).
competir.val.copaPelea: A World cup does not draw at every fight: it draws its entrants at every season.
competir.val.rango: {campo} has to be a whole number between {min} and {max}.
competir.val.reglas: The chosen rules are not a valid scenario.
competir.reglas.f1.desc: the F1 league settings: costs, physics and a toroidal 9237 × 6928 field.
competir.reglas.sincostos.desc: the F1 base with every cost at 0: bots spend no energy.
competir.reglas.escenario.desc: the options and objects of a scenario (built-in, your own or the Experiment draft), without its species.
competir.reglas.clasica: These rules come from the classic interface (its options panel): choosing others replaces them.
competir.reglas.experimentar.ayuda: Opens this world as a draft in Experiment, to look at it or retouch it (the tournament does not change).
competir.reglas.editar.ayuda: The season has no matches: they can still be changed.
competir.reglas.pasada: This is a past season: its rules stay as they were played.
competir.torneo.bloqueada: rules locked since the first match
competir.torneo.rondaBloquea: background round: entrants, draws and rules locked
competir.torneo.borrarSi: Delete the tournament and its matches?
competir.tabla.tope.ayuda: Share of the rounds it won that were decided by the cycle cap
competir.tabla.nulos: There are no draws: a void match is played again.
competir.tabla.desempate.swiss: Ties: points, Buchholz, Elo and rounds won by extinction.
competir.tabla.desempate.cup: Order: how far each one went, then wins and Elo. In the groups: wins, head to head, group Elo, fewer rounds won at the cap, fewer cycles and the draw order.
competir.tabla.desempate.ladder: Ladder order; those not placed yet, last.
competir.tabla.desempate.rr: Order: wins, then Elo and fewer matches played.
competir.tabla.desempate.kothSinFin: Order: crowns (undefeated retirements), then Elo and wins.
competir.tabla.desempate.elo: Order: Elo (1500 at the start; in a fight of N, the winner beats each of the others), then wins.
competir.tabla.h2h.ayuda: The row beat the column (in a fight of N, the winner beats each of the others).
competir.tabla.h2h.muchos: Head to head is shown with up to {max} entrants; this season has {n}.
competir.estructura.suizoRonda: Round {no} of {de} · paired by score, no repeated opponent
competir.estructura.suizoSinSorteo: The round 1 order is drawn when the first match starts.
competir.estructura.suizoEsperan: {n} entrants joined later: they play from the next season.
competir.estructura.suizoAyuda: ↻ replays the match with its seed and warns if the result differs.
competir.estructura.copaSinSorteo: The groups are drawn when the first match starts (or in Entrants).
competir.estructura.gruposAyuda: The top 2 of each group go through. Ties: head to head, group Elo, fewer rounds won at the cap, fewer cycles and the draw order.
competir.estructura.bombosElo: Pots by the tournament's all-time Elo ({elo} without history): one entrant of each pot per group.
competir.estructura.rey: 👑 {nombre} on the hill · {n} of {de} to retire
competir.estructura.sinRey: The hill has no king: the next fight is open
competir.partidos.porTope.ayuda: Rounds decided by the cycle cap
competir.partidos.repetirNo: Replay match #{no} with the same seed
competir.partidos.ayuda: Every match keeps its summary and its seed. ↻ replays it with the same rules, entrants and seed and warns if it differs; “Replay and analyze” runs it again and opens it as a run in Analyze.
competir.participantes.congelado: Each entrant keeps the DNA it had when it joined.
competir.participantes.cantidad.ayuda: Bots of this species; empty = the format's ({n})
competir.participantes.vacio: Add at least 2 entrants, or draw them.
competir.participantes.vivos: Drawn from the pool as the season is played.
competir.participantes.sortear.ayuda: Replace the entrants with this many drawn at random from the pool
competir.participantes.sorteoBloqueado: This season has matches: start a new season to draw again.
competir.participantes.gruposElo: Pots by the tournament's all-time Elo (1500 without history): one of each pot per group.
competir.temporadas.nueva.ayuda: A new season unlocks format, match values and rules; the entrants carry over or are drawn again, depending on the mode.
competir.temporadas.historica.ayuda: {n} seasons · {completas} complete. Elo carries over from season to season.
competir.salon.ayuda: Every saved tournament: one row per DNA (the same bot under another name in another tournament is the same row). A single Elo over every match, in date order.
competir.salon.vacio: No match has been played in a saved tournament yet.
competir.jugar.elegir: Choose a tournament or the quick match to play.
competir.jugar.ronda.ayuda: The round runs without drawing at full speed, on up to {n} workers. Every match uses its own seed: the result is the same as watching it.
competir.jugar.delPool: The next fight's entrants come from the pool when it starts.
competir.jugar.faltan: Add at least 2 entrants (Entrants) or draw them.
competir.jugar.alEmpezar: The order is drawn when the first match starts.
competir.jugar.otroEnJuego: A match of another tournament is playing.
competir.jugar.rondaEnCurso: In the background · up to {n} workers
competir.jugar.rondaEstado.pendiente: The round waits for its turn in the queue.
competir.jugar.rondaEstado.terminado: The round is over: recording it…
competir.jugar.rondaEstado.fallido: The round failed: release it and ask for another.
competir.jugar.rondaEstado.cancelado: The round was cancelled: release it and ask for another.
competir.jugar.rondaSinTrabajo: The round is not in the queue (it was deleted or is being queued).
competir.jugar.alterado: The match was abandoned and is not recorded: its simulation received live changes while it was being played.
competir.jugar.rondaBloquea: Until the round is recorded you cannot play by hand or change entrants, draws or rules.
competir.ronda.encolada: Background round: {n} matches in the queue. You will be told when it ends.
competir.marcador.extendido: extended from {de} to {a} rounds by statistical draw
competir.marcador.chipAyuda: Show the scoreboard of the match in progress
competir.informe.listo: Report generated: {archivo} (it is also in Analyze → Reports).
competir.informe.error: The report could not be generated: {detalle}
competir.informe.tpl.desc: Standings, format structure, Elo and matches with their seeds of a tournament's last season.
competir.informe.temporadaNota: The report covers its last season (another season's report is generated from Compete).
competir.jugar.auto.ayuda: Plays the whole season without intervention in Observe, with the side panel in view and a break screen between fights; at the end it announces the champion and goes on with another edition. Every fight is recorded in the tournament.
competir.jugar.tv.ayuda: Plays the whole season hands-free, full screen, with breaks between fights; at the end it announces the champion and goes on with another edition with a new draw. Every fight is recorded in the tournament.
